name: Bhuvan Cartosat-3 Ortho Imagery (India)
crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS84 geographic); projected tiles in UTM
labels: No building labels — raw imagery only. Building footprints must be derived separately.
license: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) data policy. Non-commercial research use subject to NRSC approval and data sharing agreement.
provenance: Requested through Bhuvan Geoportal or NRSC Data Dissemination Policy portal. User registration required.
limitations: Access requires NRSC/ISRO registration and project justification. High-resolution data (sub-1m) may require additional clearance. Cloud cover varies by season. No building-level labels included.
intended_use: Task 1 (building extraction imagery source), Task 3 (height estimation visual context), Task 8 (change detection — multi-temporal)
